name: Tokuno Shohei
source:
He is a aimless man who has just lost his job.

He is a hedonistic yet cunning and vindictive character who always accomplishes what he decides to do.

He was pessimistic about his life because of his proclivity for dominating and abusing women, but  when he met Fumika and other women on a whimsical sightseeing trip, he decided to follow his own desires and live his life.

He has strong vigor and can have sex many times a day if he wants to.

In addition, he has had the experience of torturing a woman in uniform at his company.

He is also a man who is determined to live his life according to his desires, especially when he is working hard at his job.

He has developed a lust for working women, especially those who are in the midst of performing their duties.

Translated from http://www.bishop.jp/products/cs2/manual/index.html
